page_title: BOC 0-1 FRE | Bochum v Freiburg 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Matus Bero (Bochum) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Jakov Medic (Bochum) coming on for Gerrit Holtmann.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Eren Dinkci and he is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
90' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Merlin Rohl is replaced by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg).

90' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Patrick Drewes. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
90' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' Matus Bero (Bochum) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
87' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Matus Bero (Bochum), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

86' This was a piece of cake for Noah Atubolu. Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
84' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
81' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
80' Dieter Hecking decides to make a substitution. Tim Oermann will be replaced by Mats Pannewig (Bochum).
79' Myron Boadu (Bochum) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is replacing Maximilian Eggestein.
76' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
74' The attendance for today's match is 25000.

74' Golden chance! Matus Bero (Bochum) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
72' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
71' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
68' Tom Krauss (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Substitution. Maximilian Wittek makes way for Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).
63' A substitution has been made. Moritz Broschinski is replaced by Myron Boadu (Bochum).
63' Dieter Hecking has decided to make a change. Tom Krauss (Bochum) replaces Dani de Wit.
63' Bernardo (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
60' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) whips in a cross from the corner, but Patrick Drewes is well positioned and punches the ball away.
60' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
59' Patrick Drewes pulls off a great save to deny Eren Dinkci (Freiburg), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
58' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
58' Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg).
55' Freiburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
51' Matus Bero (Bochum) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
51' A cross into the box from Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) is cleared.
48' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

47' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
46' Referee Tobias Welz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Christian Gunter (Freiburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
42' Matus Bero (Bochum) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
41' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Welz saw the whole situation.
39' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 0:1.
34' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
34' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
32' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.

29' A fine solo run by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
26' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and it's Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
21' Some neat passing and movement from Bochum as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
18' Tobias Welz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg).
12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
10' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
6' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Welz who sees an offensive foul.
5' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Tobias Welz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
